src/focus/alignment/preview.py::_image_t.reason: Display conversion kernel retains image-axis handling, PCA/channel selection and dtype/intensity scaling together; its output is the browser preview rather than native scientific data.

src/focus/alignment/result.py::parse_ali.reason: Browser-transform decoding and native-coordinate application form one geometry kernel. Matrix versus legacy coordinate branches retain their original fallback and scaling behavior.

src/focus/annotations/transfer.py::trans.reason: Polygon-membership kernel keeps ordered annotation overwrite semantics, spatial scaling and categorical result construction together; its geometry arrays are shared only within this operation.

src/focus/gui/routes/alignment.py::regis.reason: Ordered alignment HTTP route declarations share the current sample state; every endpoint callable meets the target. The enclosing declaration preserves endpoint names and asset routes.

src/focus/gui/routes/browser.py::registe.reason: Related filesystem-browser endpoint declarations retain registration order and closure state; individual endpoint handlers meet the callable target.

src/focus/gui/routes/configuration.py::r.reason: Ordered Flask route declarations share one GUI instance; individual endpoint callables meet the callable target. Route registration order and endpoint names are HTTP contract details.

src/focus/gui/routes/samples.py::registe.reason: Related sample-scaffolding endpoint declarations share one GUI context and preserve endpoint names/order; individual handlers remain within the callable target.

src/focus/gui/schema.py::_build_schema.reason: The static GUI form schema is one ordered serialized declaration. Keeping it together makes field/default/choice parity reviewable against the unchanged frontend contract.

src/focus/preprocessing/msi/backbone.py:.reason: Mass-scale graph kernel retains pairwise offset estimates, connectivity, fixed cached anchors and least-squares solve together so the gauge and disconnected-component behavior remain explicit.

src/focus/preprocessing/msi/binary.py::B.reason: Bounded binary-validation scan retains dtype/range checks, file-handle lifetime, chunk visitation and non-finite spectrum accumulation in the same order; truncation errors must precede downstream processing.

src/focus/preprocessing/msi/coordinates..reason: Fallback polarity-pairing kernel evaluates acquisition orientation, raster alignment and stable intersection together; a different candidate or tie order changes paired spectra.

src/focus/preprocessing/msi/feature_meta.reason: Ordered shared feature-table declaration includes polarity column ranges, categorical annotations and internal-standard column validation. The resulting table and column ranges must agree exactly.

src/focus/preprocessing/msi/features.py:.reason: Feature-density kernel retains smoothing, local-floor significance, peak bounds and weighted m/z estimates together; splitting these intermediate arrays can hide changes to peak boundaries.
Streaming log-mass histogram kernel grows its accumulators while consuming bounded peak blocks; one scope preserves allocation growth, bin origin shifts and exact integer/float accumulation order.

src/focus/preprocessing/msi/imzml.py::Im.reason: The imzML acquisition metadata declaration keeps dtype/raster decoding, spectrum-table construction and coordinate fallback in their established order before returning the existing dictionary representation.
One spectrum metadata declaration decodes ordered CV entries into binary ranges and physical/pixel coordinates; preserving the branch order also preserves malformed-input errors.

src/focus/preprocessing/msi/matching.py:.reason: Numba-compatible matching kernel keeps its monotone mass search and ppm comparisons in one compiled loop; Python adapters or closures inside the kernel would change compilation and execution.
Compiled ppm-offset histogram kernel retains spectrum/reference iteration and bin accumulation order; the whole loop is the numerical unit compiled by Numba.
Robust sample-offset kernel couples the search histogram, mode selection and residual summary on a common ppm grid, including original empty/missing cases.

src/focus/preprocessing/msi/microgrid.py.reason: Microgrid outlier kernel shares its background-ion model, robust scores and spatial thresholds across local closures. It remains separate from tissue GMM detection because the scientific assumptions differ.

src/focus/preprocessing/msi/normalizatio.reason: Alternative normalization formulas stay in one dispatch kernel to make dtype preservation and input nonmutation comparable across methods; internal-standard filling remains specific to its own branch.

src/focus/preprocessing/msi/recalibratio.reason: Coupled robust recalibration kernel retains coarse/narrow matching, line slope/offset fits, smoothing and pixel residual filling. Shared closures encode the same reference mass scale and rejection thresholds.

src/focus/preprocessing/msi/references.p.reason: Calibrant-selection kernel retains isolation, recurrence, trial matching, required standards and ranked selection together; changing evaluation or tie order could alter the chosen reference ions.

src/focus/preprocessing/msi/sample_data..reason: Polarity assembly kernel allocates float32 raw/normalized matrices, fills positive then negative column blocks and converts both to CSR at the original release points.
One AnnData sample schema declares raw/normalized payloads, spatial/raster arrays, categorical observations and provenance, followed by the unchanged analytical-label assignment.

src/focus/preprocessing/msi/tissue.py::d.reason: Spectral-complexity tissue model is one numerical kernel: feature scaling, GMM/BIC selection and spatial cleanup share the same sampled spectra, random state and threshold decisions.

src/focus/preprocessing/raman/lif_metada.reason: Leica acquisition metadata declaration keeps dimension scaling, spectral fields and tile-position decoding together; the same nullable fields and validation order are preserved for malformed scans.

src/focus/preprocessing/raman/stitching..reason: ASHLAR input declaration retains coordinate flipping, quantization, reference-channel selection and per-cycle OME plane/channel metadata beside the ordered TIFF writes.
Preview mosaic kernel keeps channel-to-scan placement, weighted overlap accumulation, division and PCA/CLAHE visualization together; this preview controls subsequent Raman background segmentation.

src/focus/preprocessing/transcriptomics/.reason: Spatial-unit clustering kernel keeps eligibility/label back-projection and per-spot provenance coupled to the exact unit plan, without persisting or mutating analytical intermediates.

src/focus/registration/encoder.py::Micro.reason: Model/device setup, resident normalization tensors and token-layout declarations stay adjacent to the original readout compatibility check; authentication remains conditional on model absence.
Ordered foreground-grid batching kernel shares working batch size with recursive OOM recovery and progress. Output concatenation and coordinate selection use the same retained foreground indices.

Window-group readout kernel couples probe sizing, token memberships, padded queries, OOM backoff, scatter order and per-spot progress. Splitting its live batch state would obscure the numerical and memory order.

src/focus/registration/raman_pixel.py::R.reason: One TIFF axis-normalization kernel: metadata fallback, singleton squeezing, channel transposition and crop slicing retain their original evaluation order and float32 output.

src/focus/registration/readout.py::plan_.reason: Pure window-planning kernel retains clipping, token rounding, stride snapping, stable grouping and chunk sorting together so boundary/tie decisions remain inspectable in one coordinate frame.

src/focus/registration/readout.py::reado.reason: Vectorized footprint/token membership kernel includes the single-token fallback and subsequent background removal; these operations and their row order form one readout definition.

src/focus/runtime/reporting.py::StepRepo.reason: Generator protocol kernel keeps sample contexts, cancellation checks, progress increments and finally cleanup around each yield. Extracting the yield lifecycle risks changing close and interruption semantics.

src/focus/spatial/clustering.py::cluster.reason: Shared clustering orchestration: each step's early exit (foreground mode, too few spots, units, features or components) returns the same label array and provenance, which the steps fill in order; the steps themselves are separate functions.

src/focus/spatial/clusters.py::merge_uns.reason: Adjacent-cluster density kernel retains graph construction, valley ratios and label union order in one scope; these determine exact cluster partitions and reported merge diagnostics.

src/focus/spatial/lattice.py::infer_latt.reason: Lattice inference kernel keeps sampled neighbours, direction selection, basis fitting and lattice acceptance tests together; all use the same seeded sample and geometric tolerances.

src/focus/spatial/membership.py::pixel_f.reason: Chunked pixel-footprint kernel retains flattened pixel ordering, geometric membership and optional Gaussian weights before CSR assembly, including empty-footprint behavior.

src/focus/spatial/smoothing.py::smoothin.reason: Sparse smoothing kernel keeps regular-grid and irregular-neighbour branches with their original weights, edge handling and CSR construction; it defines one shared spatial operator.

src/focus/spatial/transforms.py::fit_anc.reason: Geometric fit-selection kernel keeps identity/translation/homography/local-affine fallbacks and residual tolerances together so the selected map and placeable-row mask agree.

src/focus/spatial/units.py::plan_spatial.reason: Spatial-unit planning kernel couples lattice inference, cap/signal decisions and irregular-layout fallback. Its integer rounding, count aggregation and seeded Voronoi decisions must remain ordered.

tests/characterization/stage_contract.py.reason: Controlled stage-contract fixture declaration retains the fake stage callbacks, fixed clock and complete eight-case output/progress/invalidation snapshots in one reviewable definition.

tests/characterization/test_annotation_s.reason: The paired AnnData/GeoJSON fixture declaration holds source-frame coordinates, categories and expected modality maps together so all annotation scenarios use identical inputs.

tests/characterization/test_contracts.py.reason: Original configuration, schema, geometry and numerical contract fixture is one ordered declaration; the recorded dictionary is compared in full rather than selecting convenient fields.

tests/encoding/grid_contract.py::run_gri.reason: Controlled grid workflow fixture declares its tiny encoder, logical file and image identities and IO hooks together; these shared closures make cold/cache/forced/invalidation snapshots independent of temporary paths.
